These five manually migrated examples use native `variables`, exact named
answers and real teacher/authored checks. No approvals are supplied: ordinary
publishing must fail until a teacher records decisions. To inspect the examples
without granting approval, explicitly run
`CTM_VARIANTS=review quarto render generated-variants.qmd --profile variants-review`.

Use the installed `question-variants.py` and connected review helper for the
actual include file and stable label; see [the authoring guide](docs/build-time-variants.md).
Review mode shows proposals with a banner and `variant: null`; it is not a
student release or an approval write.

## Geometric coordinates

The board is an illustration. The native question grades typed coordinates;
this example does not claim native external graphical-response grading.

```{.jsxgraph assessment_id="variant-point" width="480" height="360"}
var board=JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID,{boundingbox:[-3,3,3,-3],axis:true,keepaspectratio:true});
board.create('point',[0.5,0.5],{name:'P',snapToGrid:false});
```
